summary_1line: Sugriva encourages the despairing Rama, urging resolve, promising the monkeys’ strength, and proposing building a bridge across the ocean to assault Lanka.

image_candidates.scene_text: Rama stands gazing at the vast ocean in despair while Sugriva speaks beside him, gesturing confidently toward the distant southern horizon.
Sugriva addresses a gathered host of monkey warriors, who raise rocks and trees in fierce readiness to march against Lanka.
Rama listens thoughtfully as Sugriva points across the sea toward the imagined city of Lanka atop Mount Trikuta.
